items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: In fact, I think the best bass solo I ever took was with Shadow Wilson.

ctx.x: Shadow Wilson was -- well, I have to say this. Shadow Wilson came in when I was working with Basie -- they had to cut the show. They paid Gus, but they
had him lay off and had Shadow Wilson come in and play the show. Shadow was expert. He was one of my favorite drummers. In fact, I think the best bass solo I ever took was with Shadow Wilson.
